summary: Build packages without recursive cleanup and release storage diagnostics

delivery.outcome: Make package builds work with the Wellman-selected environment without pip upgrade or recursive cleanup; release the additive storage CLI as 2.3.0 with synchronized metadata and updated canonical documentation.
nonGoals: No PyPI upload or unqualified tag
No runtime dependencies, user data cleanup, policy changes or application source edits

architecture.decision: Replace build dependency on clean and direct pip with Wellman python -m build, add the build frontend to development extras and an overridable BUILD_OUT. Keep VERSION canonical and its static pyproject mirror synchronized. Update existing canonical information and analysis documents.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the scoped build/version change; installed package backups remain private operational recovery.

commands: Inspect wheel and source distribution metadata and package source digests
